$comment: Golden cases for the Agent Engineering kit. One file, two layers.
LAYER A (deterministic, runs in npm test via scripts/test-evals.mjs):
Given a case's risk flags, forge.mjs start must produce the expected
tier, team and skip set. This is a pure function of its inputs, so it
is a real regression suite for the router - change chooseTeam and these
LAYER B (needs a model; graded against this same file):
Run the request against the fixture repository with a real model and
grade two things Layer A cannot reach:
1. routing judgment - did the model choose expect_risk itself?
2. specialist depth - did the selected expert CATCH the planted
Layer A proves the right specialist was called. Only Layer B proves the
specialist was deep enough to find anything, which is the difference
between a routing failure and a depth failure - they are fixed in
Planted defects live in evals/fixture/ and are labelled in-file.

cases.request: Add OAuth login so users can sign in with Google
cases.note: The original P2 defect. The natural vocabulary here (oauth, login, sso) matched no keyword, so this routed with no Security expert at all.

cases.request: The footer still says 2024, fix the copyright year
cases.note: The kit must not run enterprise ceremony for a one-line fix. Two roles, no brief sections beyond four.

cases.request: Users report they can see other people's orders by changing the id in the URL

planted.must_catch: getOrder reads by id with no ownership or tenant check

cases.request: The orders page takes 8 seconds to load in production

planted.must_catch: listAllOrders has no LIMIT or pagination on a growing table

cases.acceptance_note: kind=performance requires a before AND after measurement, stated as a percentile.

cases.request: Some customers were charged twice last night

planted.must_catch: chargeWithRetry re-POSTs with no idempotency key, so a timeout that succeeded upstream double-charges

cases.request: Make the promo banner look nicer on mobile

planted.must_catch: infinite animation with no prefers-reduced-motion guard
#9aa0a6 on #ffffff is ~2.8:1, below the 4.5:1 AA threshold

cases.request: Add a nullable status column to orders and backfill it
cases.note: irreversible must demand approval before build, and Data must own the expand/migrate/contract sequence.

cases.request: Extract the duplicated date formatting into a shared helper
cases.acceptance_note: kind=refactor must finish only with tests UNMODIFIED; forge.mjs enforces this mechanically.

cases.request: Is this branch safe to ship?
cases.note: Release readiness is the audit path, not a separate role. Builder must be absent and build must be unreachable.
Omitting the risk assessment must stay visible rather than passing as safety.
